newsitem.title: UK: UK's Inchcape to sell unit for 380 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK's Inchcape to sell unit for 380 mln stg.

text.p: British motors and distribution group Inchcape Plc said on Wednesday it has agreed to sell its unit Inchcape Testing Services (ITS) to Charterhouse Development Capital Ltd for around 380 million pounds in cash.
It also said the sale will give rise to an exceptional profit before tax of around 180 million pounds.
Inchcape said the sale was a major step towards focusing the company as an international distribution group and that proceeds would be used to reduce group borrowings.

The company said that ITS is the world's largest non-automotive testing organisation operating 175 testing laboratories and 342 offices in over 80 countries in Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
